purpose: Teach: 富豪/調教/落胆/軍部/反感/進入/出没/盗作

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、富豪の慈善が医療の発展を支えた事例を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Ren, we reference cases where philanthropic funding has supported medical advancement with our whole team.
lines.style: Clear, steady tone. Professional framing of the statement. Matter-of-fact delivery—informative without being pedantic. Slight pause after his name to acknowledge him directly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、犬の調教を活かしたセラピー犬の活用を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're integrating therapy dogs trained from working dog programs into our patient care protocols as a team.
lines.style: Warm confirmation. Patient, unhurried pace. Slight emphasis on 「we」—inclusive, collaborative. The tone of someone explaining what matters, not just what's protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療結果に落胆する患者さんへのケアを、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: You've noticed the care your hospital provides to patients who are discouraged by their treatment outcomes, haven't you, Doctor.
lines.style: Careful, observant phrasing. Soft but genuine—he's checking his own perception, not testing her. Respectful pause before 「sensei」. The voice of someone noticing something true.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の軍部関連の医療記録を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes, we consult historical medical records from wartime documentation with our team to inform our approach.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. She meets the weight of the subject without flinching. Professional but not cold—the voice of someone who knows what she's saying matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療政策への反感を抱く市民への対応を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: You've seen how your hospital responds to citizens who are skeptical of medical policy, haven't you, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not accusation. Thoughtful cadence. He's asking because he wants to understand, not to challenge. Respectful but engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症の進入を防ぐ国境医療検査を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team handles cross-border health screening to prevent the spread of infectious disease at entry points.
lines.style: Direct and composed. Clear enumeration of responsibility. Clinical tone but with underlying care—she's describing something essential. Steady, authoritative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 珍しい症状の出没事例を、貴院、医療チームで分析されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital analyzes emergence patterns of rare symptoms with your medical team, don't you, Doctor.
lines.style: Observant, almost marveling. Gentle affirmation of what he's discovered. Respectful phrasing—he's acknowledging her work without flattery. Soft, authentic.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医学論文の盗作を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Yes, our team monitors medical literature for plagiarism and research integrity.
lines.style: Direct, final statement. Calm and definitive. Close the conversation with quiet confidence—she's stated what matters clearly. No uncertainty.
